decisions.reason: A newly launched safety shoe line is the firm's core business, and such lines typically stay on the market for several years.
A comfort insole is a low-cost complementary accessory that supports shoe sales and fits the firm's foot-measurement and service offering.
Supportive insoles meet ergonomic and orthopedic needs in workwear and cost little to keep in the range.
The ergonomic series has its own web page, which shows strategic emphasis on a growing core segment.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a certified specialist niche with long product cycles, so an early withdrawal is unlikely.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page as a flagship, so the firm is likely to keep backing it.
